items.quote: If your Clients Always ask for Discount - use this Frame Most agents panic when a client asks for a discount.
items.statement: When a client asks for a discount, ask them one question: "If you had 3 buyers for your car - one offering full price, and 2 asking for a discount - which would you choose?"

items.quote: Developers aren't charities. They give discounts when they HAVE to, not when they WANT to.
items.statement: Developers give discounts when they HAVE to, not when they WANT to.

items.quote: Discounted units are the ones sitting on the market.
